title: Can Speech Therapy be paired with other therapies, like OT or ABA?
metaTitle: Integrated Therapies at Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: Explore how Pinnacle Blooms Network combines Speech Therapy, Occupational Therapy and ABA therapy to deliver an all-encompassing development approach for children with Autism.
html: Absolutely! Pinnacle Blooms Network recognizes the unique needs of each child and acknowledges that a multi-focused approach is often the best way to support holistic growth. Our team of experts in Speech Therapy, Occupational Therapy and ABA (Applied Behavior Analysis) work collaboratively to deliver seamless, integrated therapy experiences. This collaborative approach ensures that even as your child travels through different therapies, they're constantly building on their skills and making meaningful progress.
